description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the guild treasury: a squat stone house with a slate roof, a heavy iron-banded oak door with a big padlock, small barred windows, two iron-bound chests and an open sack of gold coins by the door, no people and no figures
